title: Avorria RC Commercial Pricing Configuration
description: Authoritative margin and markup settings by product category. Fill in the values below to activate retail pricing across the storefront.
notes: Landed cost is calculated server-side: (Supplier Net EUR + Inbound Freight EUR) * (1 + Customs Tariff) * FX Rate.
Markup percentage is added to Landed Cost to determine Ex-Tax Retail Price.
UK storefront displays VAT-inclusive price (+20%). US storefront displays pre-tax price.
Landed cost and gross margin are strictly confidential and NEVER exposed to the storefront API.
Set configured to true once you have entered your desired markup percentages.

COMPLETE_KIT.name: Complete Car Kits (e.g. MTC2R, MBX8R, MRX6X, MSX1)
COMPLETE_KIT.example_note: e.g. 35% markup on ~€529 net kit lands at ~£765 - £799 inc VAT

OPTION_PART.name: Option & Hop-Up Parts (Carbon, Titanium, Aluminum upgrades)
OPTION_PART.example_note: e.g. 50% - 65% markup on high-value option parts

REPLACEMENT_PART.name: Genuine Spare & Replacement Parts (Arms, Pins, Belts, Plastics)

TOOLS.name: Specialist Pit & Setup Tools (Wrenches, Spring Tools, Gauges)

ACCESSORY.name: Accessories & Consumables (Silicone Shock/Diff Oils, Grease, Threadlock)

ENGINE.name: Engines & Tuned Exhaust Pipes (Ninja Nitro Engines & Manifolds)
